Hours for fri do not match the ficha.

findings.quote: If it is dirty, scrub it clean with soap and warm water before you put it back.
findings.why: Scrubbing a knocked-out tooth with soap damages the periodontal ligament cells that the reimplant depends on, which contradicts mainstream dental guidance (ADA, AAE) to rinse gently with water or milk and not scrub or handle the root.
findings.fix: Replace with: rinse the tooth gently with milk or water for a few seconds, without scrubbing or removing tissue fragments, then reimplant it if you can or keep it moist in milk.

findings.quote: We are open Monday through Thursday from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., and on Friday from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.
findings.why: The ficha lists Friday hours as 08:00 to 13:00, not 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., so the post gives patients wrong hours during an emergency.
findings.fix: Change the sentence to: We are open Monday through Thursday from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., and on Friday from 8 a.m. to 1 p.m.

findings.quote: A patient who came in last month with a cracked molar on a Thursday evening told us she was out the door pain-free within the hour.
findings.why: The ficha says no patient testimonials are on file, so this invented patient story is fabricated, and the Thursday evening visit also conflicts with the clinic closing at 5 p.m. on Thursday while the pain-free promise is a guarantee-style outcome claim.
findings.fix: Delete the sentence entirely, or replace it with a general, non-testimonial description of what the emergency visit involves.

findings.quote: The ADA's [MouthHealthy page on dental emergencies](https://www.mouthhealthy.org/all-topics-a-z/dental-emergencies) lists common cases and what to do.
findings.why: I cannot verify that this URL exists or that the page says what the post claims, so the citation is unverified and could be a fabricated or broken source.
findings.fix: Open the link and confirm it resolves and covers dental emergencies before publishing, or remove the citation and the claim about what the page contains.

findings.quote: Dental emergencies rarely happen at a convenient time.
findings.why: This generic opening line reads as filler typical of AI-generated text and adds little information for the reader.
findings.fix: Open with a concrete statement, such as: Most dental emergencies need a same-day decision, so knowing the first steps helps.
